coordinate_system: X from the northeast street corner west along Tiantong Road, Y south into the block, Z from the side-door threshold. Metres.

survey.uncertainty: Brick flue's absolute setback is weakly observed. Allowing the front Y to vary by 0.70 m also moves X by about 1.13 m and Z by about 0.60 m at essentially the same image residual. The enclosed deck and the hidden returns of the rooftop masses are display closures.

sources.name: Qiao Zhengyue, Iconic red brick facade reminiscent of former glory of innovative hospital in city, May 2020
sources.image_use: Independent measurements on the published exterior. No photographic pixels are included in the public plate.

sources.name: Dai Zoujun, 公济医院仅存的老建筑, 1 April 2020
2015-12 and 2019-05 public panoramic imagery of Tiantong Road and Zhapu Road
sources.detail: Repeated square corbels have a stepped head and narrowed lower shoulder. The brick shaft has a single stringcourse below it and a narrow cap. The multi-line grille high behind the shaft belongs to the adjoining roof.

court_features.qualification: The right-hand end of the courtyard plate meets the adjoining return and the west corner is screened by a different building. The inner roof surface and the room's depth are approximate. The upper balcony below the cornice is uncovered.
